propositions: The dc_store_copy_repo fixture calls git fetch/archive/ls-tree with capture_output=True and check=True, which discards git's stderr and raises CalledProcessError carrying only exit status, making failures undiagnostic.
A transient network blip on the single un-retried git fetch origin tickets call aborts the entire 41-minute live job with an ERROR, blocking coverage.
The fixture must raise RuntimeError carrying the command, exit status, and git's verbatim stderr instead of letting CalledProcessError swallow the diagnostic.
The git fetch operation must retry a bounded number of times with backoff before final failure, but policy must be retry-then-FAIL not retry-then-skip so misconfiguration still reds the lane.
Unit tests must verify the failure message contains git's stderr verbatim, the retry backs off and respects attempt bounds, and no subprocess.run call pairs capture_output with check.
